name: thirdweb
description: Zero-dependency local stub. See ../README.md — this app never instantiates @lucid-agents/wallet's ThirdwebWalletConnector, so the real `thirdweb` package (and the wagmi/walletconnect/reown/coinbase tree it drags in) is never actually loaded; this stub just satisfies the peerDependency without installing ~400 unused packages.
